scientific_objective.primary: Produce a weighted constrained-realization ensemble, not one selected seed, that preserves the CF4 low/intermediate-k posterior, represents Virgo, Coma, Local Void, Bootes Void and surrounding cosmography, adds Local-Group information under an explicit separate likelihood, retains unconstrained high-k LCDM Gaussian power, and can be promoted to contamination-controlled RAMSES/HOP zooms.
scientific_objective.scope_of_v8: Low-resolution Local-Group proposal adequacy test only; not a final Local-Group implementation or final IC validation.

v8_verdict.dominant_mechanism: Almost-empty same-pair intersection of hard P2, pair-recentered P1, and the z=0 pair likelihood; not a long-tailed q importance ratio.
v8_verdict.importance_ratio_evidence: The defensive proposal guarantees p(q)/g(q) <= 2 and seed 5422 has log correction -0.6767. Other realizations receive zero final support from the physical gate intersection.

material_findings: The V8 proposal audit estimated soft-likelihood ESS but the final target additionally imposed the rare same-pair hard-P2 and recentered-P1 intersection; its claimed cluster bootstrap was an iid row bootstrap.
Only the midpoint q was transported although success also depends on small-scale phase, peak axis, conditioning noise, and peak morphology.
Freeing N64-N192 modes has not been shown to preserve the full CF4 distance-velocity likelihood or posterior covariance; five P1 summary gates are insufficient evidence.
The latent target must explicitly choose between a normalized design-prior mixture over P(field given peak constraints,q) and a peak-data posterior that requires q/axis-dependent marginal evidence.
Pair-midpoint recentering is not identical to the MW observer location and requires an explicit physical coordinate contract.
The uniform pair prior remains sensitive to loose preselection and PM halo fragmentation.
Lineage checks omit exact expected seed identity, explicit zero-weight P1 failures, projection-field rehashing, some manifest-P2 consistency checks, and several negative unit tests.
